steps.name: prepare-unused-import-fix
steps.run:
set -Eeuo pipefail
OUT="$PWD/.local_relay/output/fixed/scripts"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
source = Path('scripts/semantic_readable_flow_test.py')
text = source.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
needle = '    job,\n'
if text.count(needle) != 1:
    raise SystemExit(f'expected exactly one unused job import, found {text.count(needle)}')
fixed = text.replace(needle, '', 1)
target = Path('.local_relay/output/fixed/scripts/semantic_readable_flow_test.py')
target.write_text(fixed, encoding='utf-8')
PY
python3 -m py_compile .local_relay/output/fixed/scripts/semantic_readable_flow_test.py
sha256sum scripts/semantic_readable_flow_test.py .local_relay/output/fixed/scripts/semantic_readable_flow_test.py
printf '%s\n' 'FIXED_READABLE_FLOW_IMPORT_OK'
